selected.title: Eurosystem brings central bank money to tokenised finance
selected.summary: The European Central Bank has launched Pontes, a solution that enables wholesale transactions in tokenised assets to be settled in central bank money.
selected.why: ECB launches official infrastructure enabling central bank money settlement for tokenised wholesale assets.

reason: ECB's Pontes launch raises arguable questions about central bank digital money's role in financial infrastructure and whether tokenisation requires central bank intermediation or competes with private settlement.
angle: Central banks should provide tokenised settlement infrastructure rather than leave wholesale asset settlement to private blockchain networks.
